column1: # Code requirements for the judge engine, in J only. Rows use the kinds, columns and outcomes of forms/code-rules.tsv; no expected answer is carried.
# Engine generation has no external code-check gates. The retained row states a code requirement; it does not promise execution by the generation cycle.
# The map is code-map.json in the engine command's working directory: one JSON object with optional adapter names stand (starting and stopping stand
# processes), transport (sockets and HTTP to the stand and the stub), files (reading J input and writing the report). Each value is an import path of a package of the engine's
# main module, as go list prints it. A missing map, another key or a value outside those packages fails the row as no mapping.
# name denotes a set of nontest packages of the engine's main module for the default build context, rather than a map key. module is every package,
# including adapters and packages named main. core is module except the packages named by the map and packages named main; main joins core and adapters.
# A row holds when its check holds on every package of its set; an empty set fails, and a failure names the package. Both name types are package.
# Paths: the engine opens a file of the J input only by a path that a cell of a form of the J input gives, joined to the root that the engine command receives (--spec).
# stage is the retained applicability label of the row, not an executable gate of engine generation. norm names its governing requirement.
